grammar.summary: 本课学习动名词作主语与 spend/waste 时间结构。

points.title: 动名词作主语
points.explanation: Fishing is my favourite sport. 动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数。

examples.cn: 钓鱼是我最喜欢的运动。

points.title: spend/waste time doing
points.explanation: I often fish for hours without catching anything. without + 动名词表"没有……"；spend + 时间 + doing 固定结构。

examples.en: I often fish for hours without catching anything.
examples.cn: 我常常钓几小时却一无所获。

points.title: instead of + 名词/动名词
points.explanation: But this does not worry me. Instead of catching fish, I catch old boots. 表"而不是"，后接名词或动名词。

examples.en: Instead of catching fish, they catch old boots.
examples.cn: 他们没钓到鱼，却钓上了旧靴子。

exercises.q: There was some ___ news on the radio. (excite)
He is an explorer. He leads an ___ life. (excite)
